support_claim: CRM row MER-55 records the name Meridian Energy Partners while billing records Meridian Energy Partners LLC, but no observation links the CRM identifier to the billing legal name.
justification: Under the relation contract, SAME_ENTITY requires establishing evidence of identity and name similarity or compatibility is insufficient; the packet associates crm:MER-55 with Meridian Energy Partners and billing:Meridian Energy Partners LLC with Meridian Energy Partners LLC without any observation that ties MER-55 to that billed legal entity, and no observation establishes that they are distinct counterparties.
